english: Paint with the foreground color (B), or erase pixels away (E)
chinese: 使用前景色绘画（B），或擦除像素（E）

english: Liquify pushes pixels · Blur softens · Smudge drags color along
chinese: 液化推动像素 · 模糊使图像柔化 · 涂抹拖动颜色

english: Keep the source moving with the brush between strokes; off starts every stroke at the source point
chinese: 保持源点随着画笔在笔画间移动；关闭后，每次笔画均从原始源点开始

english: Copy from the active layer only, or from every visible layer as shown
chinese: 仅复制当前图层，或按显示效果复制所有可见图层

english: How far the blur softens, in pixels
The brush trails the pointer on a string this long, so a shaky hand still draws a smooth line
chinese: 画笔以此长度跟随指针，即使手抖也能绘制平滑线条

english: Parametric lifts tonal regions. Point places anchors on the curve.
chinese: 参数曲线调整色调区域；点曲线在曲线上设置锚点。

english: RGB changes brightness. Red, green, and blue also shift the color.
chinese: RGB 调整亮度；红、绿、蓝通道同时改变颜色。

english: Drag up or down to lift or lower those tones. Drag a divider along the bottom to change which tones each region covers.
chinese: 上下拖动提升或降低色调。沿底部拖动分界线，调整各区域覆盖的色调范围。

english: Drag a point. Click to add one. Double-click a point to remove it.
chinese: 拖动控制点调整，单击添加控制点，双击移除控制点。

english: Lifts or lowers the brightest tones.
chinese: 提升或降低最亮的色调。

english: Lifts or lowers the light tones.
chinese: 提升或降低较亮的色调。

english: Lifts or lowers the dark tones.
chinese: 提升或降低较暗的色调。

english: Lifts or lowers the darkest tones.
chinese: 提升或降低最暗的色调。

english: Input and output of the selected curve point.
chinese: 所选曲线控制点的输入值与输出值。

english: Replaces this curve with a straight line or a contrast curve.
chinese: 将此曲线替换为直线或对比度曲线。

english: How much the curve also changes color strength. Zero matches Photoshop; lower keeps it to brightness, higher adds more color.
chinese: 曲线对颜色强度的影响程度。0 与 Photoshop 一致；较低值主要改变亮度，较高值增加颜色变化。

english: Drag on the picture to move the curve for the tone under the pointer.
chinese: 在图像上拖动，调整指针下方色调的曲线。

english: HSL lists every color. Color edits one family. Point Color adjusts a color you pick.
chinese: HSL 显示所有颜色；“颜色”编辑单个色系；“点颜色”调整拾取的颜色。

english: Hue shifts the color, Saturation its strength, and Luminance its brightness.
chinese: 色相改变颜色；饱和度改变颜色强度；明亮度改变亮度。

english: Shifts the selected color family around the wheel.
Makes the selected color family stronger or quieter.
Makes the selected color family lighter or darker.
Drag a color in the picture. Nearby color families move together.
chinese: 在图像上拖动颜色，相邻色系会一起变化。

english: Click the picture to save a color. Up to eight colors.
chinese: 单击图像保存颜色，最多可保存八种。

english: Shifts the picked color around the color wheel.
chinese: 沿色环偏移拾取的颜色。

english: Makes the picked color stronger or quieter.
chinese: 增强或减弱拾取的颜色。

english: Makes the picked color lighter or darker.
chinese: 提亮或压暗拾取的颜色。

english: How far in hue the adjustment reaches.
How far in saturation the adjustment reaches.
chinese: 调整覆盖的饱和度范围。

english: How far in brightness the adjustment reaches.
Dims the picture outside this color's range. It is not kept when you press OK.
chinese: 压暗此颜色范围外的图像。点击“确定”后不会保留此预览效果。

english: Three-Way shows shadows, midtones, and highlights. The other choices show one wheel.
chinese: “三向”同时显示阴影、中间调和高光色轮；其他选项显示一个色轮。

english: Controls how much the three tonal wheels overlap.
chinese: 控制三个色调色轮的重叠程度。

english: Shifts the wheels toward shadows or highlights.
chinese: 将色轮的作用范围偏向阴影或高光。

english: Drag inside the wheel. Angle sets hue, distance sets saturation.
chinese: 在色轮内拖动。角度设置色相，距离设置饱和度。

english: Hue and saturation of this wheel.
chinese: 此色轮的色相与饱和度。

english: Drag to set hue and saturation. Double-click to reset this wheel.
chinese: 拖动设置色相与饱和度，双击重置此色轮。

english: Tones from black on the left to white on the right: blacks, shadows, midtones, highlights, whites. Control-click to show the vectorscope.
chinese: 色调从左侧黑色到右侧白色：黑色、阴影、中间调、高光、白色。Control 单击显示矢量示波器。

english: Hue around the wheel, saturation outward from the center. Control-click to show the histogram.
chinese: 色相沿色环变化，饱和度从中心向外增加。Control 单击显示直方图。

english: Red, green, and blue of the pixel under the pointer.
chinese: 指针下方像素的红、绿、蓝通道值。

english: Show clipped shadows in blue on the preview.
chinese: 在预览中以蓝色显示剪切的阴影。

english: Show clipped highlights in red on the preview.
chinese: 在预览中以红色显示剪切的高光。

english: Brightens or darkens the whole picture, in stops of light. Hold Option to see clipped highlights.
chinese: 以曝光档数提亮或压暗整张图像。按住 Option 查看剪切的高光。

english: Makes light and dark tones more or less different, mostly around the middle.
chinese: 增加或减小明暗色调的差异，主要影响中间调。

english: Adjusts the bright parts of the picture. Hold Option to see clipped highlights.
chinese: 调整图像的明亮部分。按住 Option 查看剪切的高光。

english: Adjusts the dark parts of the picture. Hold Option to see clipped shadows.
chinese: 调整图像的阴暗部分。按住 Option 查看剪切的阴影。

english: Sets the brightest point. Hold Option to see clipped highlights.
chinese: 设置最亮点。按住 Option 查看剪切的高光。

english: Sets the darkest point. Hold Option to see clipped shadows.
chinese: 设置最暗点。按住 Option 查看剪切的阴影。

english: Auto balances the average color. Custom follows Temperature and Tint.
chinese: “自动”平衡平均颜色；“自定义”使用色温和色调设置。

english: Auto balances the average color. Custom follows Temperature and Tint.
chinese: “自动”平衡平均颜色；“自定义”使用色温和色调设置。

english: Click a pixel that should be neutral.
chinese: 单击应为中性色的像素。

english: Click the original layer. Click the eyedropper again to stop.
chinese: 单击原始图层，再次单击吸管停止取样。

english: Shifts the picture from blue to yellow.
chinese: 将图像从蓝色偏向黄色。

english: Shifts the picture from green to mauve.
chinese: 将图像从绿色偏向紫红色。

english: Strengthens quiet colors more than colors that are already strong, and protects skin tones.
chinese: 优先增强较弱的颜色，减少对强烈颜色的影响，并保护肤色。

english: Strengthens or weakens every color by the same amount.
chinese: 以相同幅度增强或减弱所有颜色。

english: Adds or softens contrast along broader shapes.
chinese: 增强或柔化较大形状的局部对比度。

english: Clears haze when raised, and adds haze when lowered.
chinese: 提高时去除雾气，降低时增加雾气。

english: Spreads a glow from the bright areas.
chinese: 从明亮区域向外扩散辉光。

english: Diffusion is soft and wide, Bloom is tighter, and Halation is a red fringe.
chinese: 柔光扩散宽而柔和；光晕范围较紧；红色光晕形成红色边缘。

english: Chooses how bright an area must be to glow. Has no effect until Glow is raised.
chinese: 设置产生辉光的亮度门槛。“辉光”提高后才会生效。

english: Sets how far the glow reaches. Has no effect until Glow is raised.
chinese: 设置辉光扩散的距离。“辉光”提高后才会生效。

english: Shifts the glow from cool to warm. Halation stays red. Has no effect until Glow is raised.
chinese: 将辉光从冷色偏向暖色。红色光晕保持红色。“辉光”提高后才会生效。

english: Darkens or lightens the edges. The center does not change.
chinese: 压暗或提亮边缘，中心保持不变。

english: Highlight Priority protects bright edges. Color Priority also reduces color. Paint Overlay covers the edges evenly.
chinese: 高光优先保护明亮边缘；颜色优先还会降低颜色强度；绘画叠加均匀覆盖边缘。

english: Sets where the vignette begins, from the center outward.
chinese: 从中心向外设置暗角的起始位置。

english: Makes the vignette rounder or more square.
chinese: 使暗角更圆或更接近方形。

english: Softens the edge of the vignette.
Protects bright pixels while a dark vignette is applied. Used by Highlight Priority.
chinese: 添加深色暗角时保护明亮像素。用于“高光优先”。

english: Adds film grain, strongest in the middle tones.
chinese: 添加胶片颗粒，中间调中的效果最强。

english: Makes the grain coarser or finer.
Makes the grain smoother or more uneven.
chinese: 使颗粒更平滑或更不均匀。

english: Controls how strong the sharpening is.
How far from each edge the sharpening reaches, in pixels.
chinese: 锐化从每个边缘向外延伸的距离（像素）。

english: Emphasizes fine texture over broader edges.
chinese: 强调精细纹理，而非较宽的边缘。

english: Limits sharpening to stronger edges. Hold Option to see the mask.
chinese: 将锐化限制在较明显的边缘。按住 Option 查看蒙版。

english: Smooths grain and noise in brightness.
chinese: 平滑亮度中的颗粒与杂色。

english: Preserves fine texture while luminance noise is reduced.
chinese: 降低明亮度杂色时保留精细纹理。

english: Keeps local contrast after luminance smoothing.
chinese: 明亮度平滑后保持局部对比度。

english: Preserves colored edges while color noise is reduced.
chinese: 降低颜色杂色时保留彩色边缘。

english: Makes the color smoothing softer or tighter.
chinese: 使颜色平滑更柔和或更集中。

english: Pulls red and blue fringes apart toward the center to reduce color edging.
chinese: 将红色和蓝色色边向中心分离，以减少色边。
启用镜头配置文件校正

english: Applies generic profile strength when camera metadata is not available.
chinese: 缺少相机元数据时应用通用配置强度。

english: No lens metadata on this layer. Profile sliders set generic correction strength.
chinese: 此图层没有镜头元数据。配置滑块调整通用校正强度。

english: How much of the profile distortion correction is applied.
chinese: 配置文件畸变校正的应用程度。

english: How much of the profile vignetting correction is applied.
chinese: 配置文件暗角校正的应用程度。

english: Click a purple or green fringe to set its hue range.
chinese: 单击紫色或绿色色边，设置其色相范围。

english: Click a purple or green fringe to set its hue range.
chinese: 单击紫色或绿色色边，设置其色相范围。

english: Click the fringe on the layer. Click the eyedropper again to stop.
chinese: 单击图层上的色边，再次单击吸管停止取样。

english: Weakens purple fringes inside the purple hue range.
chinese: 减弱紫色色相范围内的紫色色边。

english: Hue range where purple defringe runs.
chinese: 紫色去边作用的色相范围。

english: Weakens green fringes inside the green hue range.
chinese: 减弱绿色色相范围内的绿色色边。

english: Hue range where green defringe runs.
chinese: 绿色去边作用的色相范围。

english: Brightens or darkens the corners to counter lens falloff.
chinese: 提亮或压暗四角，以校正镜头亮度衰减。

english: Moves the vignette correction inward or outward.
chinese: 将暗角校正范围向内或向外移动。

english: Start of the hue range, in degrees.
Start of the hue range, in degrees.
End of the hue range, in degrees.
End of the hue range, in degrees.
Off leaves the picture as it is. Guided straightens from lines you draw on the picture.
chinese: “关闭”保持原图不变；“引导”根据您在图像上绘制的线条进行校正。

english: Draw two or more lines on the preview that should be level or vertical.
chinese: 在预览上绘制两条或更多应为水平或垂直的线。

english: Drag on the layer to place a guide. Draw at least two lines.
chinese: 在图层上拖动添加参考线，至少绘制两条。

english: Perspective allows stronger keystone. Rectilinear keeps the warp gentler.
chinese: 透视允许较强的梯形校正；直线投影的变形较柔和。

english: Straightens vertical lines toward the center.
chinese: 朝中心方向校正垂直线。

english: Straightens horizontal lines toward the center.
chinese: 朝中心方向校正水平线。

english: Rotates the picture around its center.
Zooms the transformed picture within the frame.
chinese: 在画框内缩放变换后的图像。

english: Moves the picture left or right.
Moves the picture up or down.
Crops empty edges after the transform and fits the result back into the frame.
chinese: 变换后裁切空白边缘，并使结果重新适合画框。

english: Chooses how strongly the calibration sliders below are applied. Version 6 is the current default.
chinese: 设置下方校准滑块的应用强度。版本 6 为当前默认版本。

english: Adds green or magenta to the darkest tones.
chinese: 向最暗色调添加绿色或洋红色。

english: Strengthens or weakens the red primary.
Strengthens or weakens the green primary.
Strengthens or weakens the blue primary.
Shift-click adds a color, Option-click takes one away.
chinese: Shift 单击添加颜色，Option 单击移除颜色。

english: Click the image to pick the color to select.
chinese: 单击图像，拾取要选择的颜色。

english: How far a color may be from the picked ones and still be selected
chinese: 与已拾取颜色的差异小于此范围时，仍会被选中

english: Select everything except those colors, such as all but a green screen
chinese: 选择这些颜色以外的所有内容，例如选择绿幕以外的内容

english: Click the image to select that color
Click the image to add that color to the selection
chinese: 单击图像，将该颜色加入选区

english: Click the image to take that color out of the selection
chinese: 单击图像，将该颜色从选区中移除

english: Click to add a point. Drag to adjust.
chinese: 单击添加控制点，拖动调整。

english: Color the result while keeping its tones, for a sepia or a cyanotype
chinese: 保持原有色调并为结果着色，可制作棕褐色或蓝晒效果

english: Put each pixel's brightness back afterwards, so only the color moves
chinese: 调整后还原每个像素的亮度，使操作仅改变颜色

english: Hide the background behind a layer mask, keeping the foreground subjects. The pixels stay, so the background can be painted back at any time.
chinese: 通过图层蒙版隐藏背景，保留前景主体。原始像素仍保留，可随时在蒙版上绘画以恢复背景。

english: Basic is quick; Advanced refines the mask against the layer's own detail, for hair and fur
chinese: “基础”速度较快；“高级”根据图层自身细节优化蒙版，适用于头发和毛发

english: Pull the mask onto the image's own edges, which recovers hair and fur
chinese: 使蒙版贴合图像本身的边缘，恢复头发和毛发细节

english: Clear the haze that leaves background showing through thin areas
chinese: 消除薄弱区域透出背景的雾状残留

english: Shrink the mask to drop the rim of background color around the subject, or grow it
chinese: 收缩蒙版以去除主体周围的背景色边缘，或扩展蒙版

english: Fill the selection using surrounding pixels from this layer.
chinese: 使用此图层周围的像素填充选区。

english: Blend the chosen color into the edges while keeping the center unchanged
chinese: 将所选颜色混合到边缘，同时保持中心不变

english: Protect bright areas near the edge
chinese: 保护边缘附近的明亮区域

english: Positive straightens lines that bow outward (barrel); negative, lines that bow inward (pincushion).
chinese: 正值校正向外弯曲的线条（桶形畸变）；负值校正向内弯曲的线条（枕形畸变）。

english: Make each dithered pixel this many pixels across, for a chunky old-screen look
chinese: 每个抖动像素的宽度，营造粗大像素的旧式屏幕效果

english: The height of each line of characters
How far apart the screen's lines are
Light blooming around the lines, like a CRT's phosphors
chinese: 在线条周围产生光晕，类似 CRT 荧光屏

english: Break the lines into glowing beads
chinese: 将线条分成发光的圆点

english: Make the lines waver sideways down the screen, like a CRT losing sync
chinese: 使线条沿屏幕横向波动，类似 CRT 失去同步的效果

english: The characters to draw with, in any order: each spot gets the one whose ink best matches its tone
chinese: 用于绘制的字符（顺序不限）；每个位置使用墨量最符合其色调的字符

english: Tones per channel: 2 is pure black and white
chinese: 每个通道的色调级数；2 为纯黑白

english: How much of each pixel's error spreads to its neighbors. Less gives flatter areas
chinese: 每个像素的误差向相邻像素扩散的程度；较低值形成更平坦的区域

english: More ink (darker) or less before dithering
chinese: 在抖动前增加墨量（变暗）或减少墨量

english: Draw each chunky pixel as a solid square, or as a round dot like a dot-matrix screen
chinese: 将粗大像素绘制为实心方块，或点阵屏幕般的圆点

english: Draw the marks for the light tones on the dark color, like a glowing screen
chinese: 在暗色上绘制亮色标记，呈现发光屏幕效果

english: Linear runs along the line; Radial spreads out from the start point
chinese: 线性渐变沿直线延伸；径向渐变从起点向外扩散
每隔 \(Double(grid.step).formatted(.number.precision(.fractionLength(0...2)))) 像素设置一个子分区。

english: Use gridlines every \(LayoutGrid.spacingRange.lowerBound)–\(LayoutGrid.spacingRange.upperBound.formatted()) pixels and \(LayoutGrid.subdivisionRange.lowerBound)–\(LayoutGrid.subdivisionRange.upperBound) subdivisions, no more than the pixels between gridlines.
chinese: 网格线间距范围为 \(LayoutGrid.spacingRange.lowerBound)–\(LayoutGrid.spacingRange.upperBound.formatted()) 像素，子分区范围为 \(LayoutGrid.subdivisionRange.lowerBound)–\(LayoutGrid.subdivisionRange.upperBound)，且不能超过网格线间的像素数。
改为作用于此范围之外

english: Targeted adjustment: drag on the image to change that color's saturation, or its hue with Command held
chinese: 目标调整：在图像上拖动以调整该颜色的饱和度；按住 Command 可调整色相

english: Zoom in (⌘+), now \(percent). At 100% each pixel of the JPEG is one pixel of the screen, as on the canvas
chinese: 放大（⌘+），当前 \(percent)。100% 时，JPEG 的每个像素对应屏幕的一个像素，与画布相同

english: Drag or scroll to move around; double-click switches between Fit and 100%
chinese: 拖动或滚动平移；双击切换“适合窗口”与 100%

english: Press M to switch between Rectangle and Ellipse
chinese: 按 M 切换矩形与椭圆

english: Press Tab to switch between Wand and Object
chinese: 按 Tab 切换魔棒与对象选择

english: Press L to switch between Freehand and Polygonal
chinese: 按 L 切换自由套索与多边形套索

english: Hold Shift to add or Option to subtract for one outline
chinese: 按住 Shift 添加，或按住 Option 减去单个轮廓

english: Smooth the detected object outline; turn off for the raw pixel mask
chinese: 平滑检测到的对象轮廓；关闭后使用原始像素蒙版

english: Smooth selection edges; turn off for hard pixel edges
chinese: 平滑选区边缘；关闭后保留硬像素边缘

english: Fade the edge of the selection by this many pixels
chinese: 按此像素数量渐隐选区边缘

english: How far each color channel (0–255) can differ from the clicked color and still be selected
chinese: 各颜色通道（0–255）与所单击颜色的差异小于此值时，仍会被选中

english: Match the clicked pixel, or the average of the pixels around it
chinese: 匹配所单击的单个像素，或其周围像素的平均值

english: Read colors from the active layer only, or from every visible layer as shown
chinese: 仅读取当前图层的颜色，或按显示效果读取所有可见图层

english: Select only similar pixels connected to the one you click; off selects them everywhere
chinese: 仅选择与单击位置相连的相似像素；关闭后选择所有位置的相似像素

english: Analyze the active layer only, or every visible layer as shown
chinese: 仅分析当前图层，或按显示效果分析所有可见图层

english: Positive values tighten the detected mask inward; negative values expand it outward
chinese: 正值向内收紧检测到的蒙版；负值向外扩展

english: \(title) the selection by this many pixels
Enter a whole number from 1 to \(maximum) px.
chinese: 输入从 1 到 \(maximum) 的整数像素值。

english: Add layer mask (Option-click for a black mask)
chinese: 添加图层蒙版（Option 单击创建黑色蒙版）

english: Add layer mask revealing the selection (Option-click to hide it)
chinese: 添加显示选区的图层蒙版（Option 单击隐藏选区）

english: Show the image again (or Option-click the mask thumbnail)
chinese: 重新显示图像（也可 Option 单击蒙版缩略图）

english: Create a canvas or import an image.
Import an image or add a blank layer.
chinese: 导入图像或添加空白图层。

english: Layer effects: stroke and drop shadow

chinese: 底层像素 · 按透明度加权的直方图
原始像素 · 按透明度加权的直方图

english: Original pixels · selection and alpha-weighted histogram
chinese: 原始像素 · 按选区与透明度加权的直方图

english: Linear histogram with automatic vertical scaling. Tall spikes may extend beyond the graph; all tones from 0 to 255 remain included.
chinese: 线性直方图会自动缩放纵轴。较高峰值可能超出图表，但仍包含 0 至 255 的全部色调。

english: Select layer; Cmd-click to select its pixels (Cmd-Shift adds, Cmd-Option subtracts)
chinese: 选择图层；Command 单击选择其像素（Command-Shift 添加，Command-Option 减去）

english: Link layer and mask so they move together
chinese: 链接图层与蒙版，使其一起移动

english: Unlink layer and mask to move or transform them separately
chinese: 取消图层与蒙版的链接，以便分别移动或变换

english: Select layer mask; Option-click to view it alone; Shift-click to enable/disable; Cmd-click to select its black areas (Cmd-Shift adds, Cmd-Option subtracts)
chinese: 选择图层蒙版；Option 单击单独查看，Shift 单击启用或停用，Command 单击选择黑色区域（Command-Shift 添加，Command-Option 减去）

english: Clipping mask based on \(sourceName). Option-click the bottom of its row to release.
chinese: 剪贴蒙版基于 \(sourceName)。Option 单击其行底部可释放。

english: Clipping mask based on \(source.name). Option-click the bottom of its row to release.
chinese: 剪贴蒙版基于 \(source.name)。Option 单击其行底部可释放。

english: Click to select; double-click to edit; Option-drag to copy
chinese: 单击选择；双击编辑；按住 Option 拖动以复制

english: Zoom percentage (0.1–3200%). Press Return to apply.
chinese: 缩放比例（0.1–3200%）。按 Return 应用。

english: Preset sizes for screens and common formats
chinese: 屏幕与常用格式的预设尺寸

english: Enter whole numbers from 1 to \(DocumentLimits.maxSide.formatted()) pixels.
chinese: 请输入从 1 到 \(DocumentLimits.maxSide.formatted()) 的整数像素值。

english: Reading the file to see what needs converting.
chinese: 正在读取文件，检查需要转换的内容。

english: Compositor will convert these Photoshop features. Nothing is applied until you continue.
chinese: Compositor 将转换这些 Photoshop 功能。点击“继续”后才会应用。
正在读取 Photoshop 文件…

english: Drop to open in a new canvas
chinese: 拖入以在新画布中打开

english: Open in a new project tab
chinese: 在新项目标签页中打开

english: New canvas (⌘N) · Drop images here for new tabs
chinese: 新建画布（⌘N）· 将图像拖至此处可新建标签页

english: Shift-U (or Tab) steps through Rectangle, Ellipse and Line
chinese: Shift-U（或 Tab）依次切换矩形、椭圆和直线

english: Round the rectangle's corners by this many pixels; 0 keeps them square
chinese: 矩形圆角半径（像素）；0 为直角

english: Shapes fill with the foreground color; click to change it
chinese: 形状使用前景色填充；单击可更改

english: Select layers by clicking the canvas. Hold Command to turn it the other way while you click.
chinese: 单击画布选择图层。按住 Command 单击可临时切换自动选择状态。

english: Show the transform box and handles (⌘H). When hidden, drag anywhere to move the layer.
chinese: 显示变换框与控制柄（⌘H）。隐藏时，可在任意位置拖动来移动图层。

english: Lock aspect ratio. Hold Shift while dragging a handle to turn it the other way.
chinese: 锁定宽高比。拖动控制柄时按住 Shift 可临时切换锁定状态。

english: Scale width and height together, about the center
chinese: 以中心为基准，同时缩放宽度与高度

english: Font face, including bold and italic variants
chinese: 字体字形，包含粗体与斜体等样式

english: Line height, baseline to baseline. Empty or 0 is Auto: 120% of the font size.
chinese: 行高（基线之间的距离）。留空或输入 0 为自动：字号的 120%。
\(bytes(draft.originalWidth, draft.originalHeight)) 未压缩的 RGBA 画布
新尺寸：\(Int(draft.width.rounded())) × \(Int(draft.height.rounded())) 像素 · \(bytes(Int(draft.width.rounded()), Int(draft.height.rounded()))) 未压缩

english: Final dimensions must be 1–\(DocumentLimits.maxSide.formatted()) pixels per side.
chinese: 最终尺寸必须在单边 1–\(DocumentLimits.maxSide.formatted()) 像素范围内。

english: Keeps this point fixed. Artwork is not scaled; cropped content remains outside the canvas.
chinese: 保持此锚点不动。图像内容不会缩放，裁切的内容仍保留在画布外。

english: Resizes layer pixels and applies existing transforms. Undo restores the originals.
chinese: 调整图层像素大小并应用现有变换。撤销可恢复原始内容。

english: Only print dimensions and resolution change. Pixels stay unchanged.
chinese: 仅改变打印尺寸和分辨率，像素保持不变。

english: Use 1–\(DocumentLimits.maxSide.formatted()) pixels per side, up to \(DocumentLimits.maxSurfaceMegapixels) megapixels, and 1–9,600 pixels/inch.
chinese: 单边范围为 1–\(DocumentLimits.maxSide.formatted()) 像素，最多 \(DocumentLimits.maxSurfaceMegapixels) 百万像素，分辨率范围为 1–9,600 像素／英寸。

english: Click the original layer to set \(ChineseUI(mode.rawValue)). Click the eyedropper again to stop.
chinese: 单击原始图层设置\(ChineseUI(mode.rawValue))。再次单击吸管停止取样。
